Support

You can always reach a person at DressYou: none of the routes below relies on automated tools alone.

In the app

[[FOUNDER: support-entry — the route to support inside the app, in the app's own words, on iPhone (I16) and on Android (AR26): write it only once the entry exists on both]]

By email

Write to [[FOUNDER: user-contact — the electronic address of the point of contact for users and people without an account]]. Messages may be written in French or in English.

When to expect an answer

[[FOUNDER: contact-staffing — Who reads these messages, and what response time does DressYou state? §4.15 asks for an honest stated expectation.]]

What a person handles

A person at DressYou handles what a help page cannot settle:

  • a capture that will not complete;
  • a twin that has been rejected more than once;
  • a billing dispute;
  • the removal of a post, above all one that shows someone who did not agree to appear;
  • a request about your data: access, correction or deletion.

Other requests

To delete an account, see Account deletion. To report a post, comment, profile or ask page, see Report content.
